title: FailureGen: Scalable Robot Failure Data Generation with World Models
abstract: arXiv:2611.22367v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Robot failures are difficult to collect at scale, limiting the range of failure scenarios represented in robot learning datasets. We present FailureGen, a method for generating synthetic videos with temporal event annotations by reusing action trajectories from recorded failures. The method comprises four stages: (1) fine-tuning an action-conditioned Cosmos world model on successful and failed real executions; (2) annotating source recordings to identify failure-associated donor segments and compatible successful hosts; (3) transferring donor motion into host contexts, with optional spatial offsets, to generate continuous video rollouts; and (4) annotating and filtering the generated samples according to observed events and visual quality. translated_title: FailureGen：基于世界模型的可扩展机器人失败数据生成
translated_abstract: 机器人失败数据难以大规模收集，这限制了机器人学习数据集中所能涵盖的失败场景范围。我们提出FailureGen，这是一种通过复用已记录失败中的动作轨迹来生成带时间事件标注的合成视频的方法。该方法包含四个阶段：（1）在成功和失败的真实执行数据上对动作条件化的Cosmos世界模型进行微调；（2）对源录制数据进行标注，以识别与失败相关的供体片段以及兼容的成功宿主片段；（3）将供体的动作转移至宿主上下文中（可附带空间偏移），以生成连续的视频rollout；（4）依据观察到的事件和视觉质量对生成的样本进行标注和过滤。我们研究了两种采用不同任务和机器人配置的实现，其中视觉失败检测作为一个下游应用。在初步比较中，基于真实数据训练的检测器（原文在此处截断）
tldr: 提出FailureGen方法，通过在世界模型中复用真实失败记录的动作轨迹，可规模化地生成带时间事件标注的合成机器人失败视频，解决失败数据难以大规模收集的问题。
en_tdlr: FailureGen enables scalable generation of synthetic robot failure videos with temporal event annotations by reusing action trajectories from recorded failures within a fine-tuned action-conditioned world model.
